description: On behalf of the 99th Readiness Division we have a requirement for Propane Delivery in Romney, WV (WV038) and Wheeling, WV (WV053). Please see Draft-Statement of Work (SOW) for requirements. This Sources Sought which is issued solely for information and planning purposes and shall not be misconstrued as a Request for Quote (RFQ), nor does it constitute a commitment to the Government. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary; the Government will not pay for information requested. Please email all inquiries to Tyler Behr and Raina Derrick at tyler.e.behr2.civ@army.mil and raina.m.derrick.civ@army.mil.
